verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same and share the same flaws. The logo badge is blown up until it competes with the headline. The dark header bar is left as a stray block in the top-right corner, and the orange divider floats alone on the right. The 'Reserve a Case' CTA is tiny and buried at the bottom-left, and 'Ships late June' and the legal line are crammed next to it at an unreadable size. A's badge pushes against the top and bottom edges of the canvas and looks cropped. B's badge sits a little more cleanly inside the canvas, so B is very slightly less bad.
